body.heading: Listen and echo
paragraphs: Your adult reads one short line in a squeaky mouse voice. You echo it back, copying the voice.
Swap voices each page: a giant voice, a robot voice, a whisper voice.

body.heading: Swap the leader
paragraphs: Now you read or say a line first, and your adult has to echo you.
The leader picks the voice. The echo copies it as closely as they can.

takeaway: Echoing a line helps your ears learn how stories sound.
safetyNotes: Choose books everyone enjoys; stop whenever you are tired.
